title: Tests: update for FINALIZE ioctl + add streaming interleave tests
description:
Update tests/userspace/test_chardev.c for the new streaming model.

Changes to existing tests:
- All existing INIT/write/read test sequences must add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE between the last write() and the first read()
- Verify existing NIST CAVP vectors still produce correct results

New streaming tests to add:
1. CBC streaming: write 64KB in 4KB chunks, read output after each write(), FINALIZE, read last block. Verify full ciphertext matches one-shot result.
2. Hash streaming: write 1MB in 4KB chunks, read() returns 0 each time (no output until FINALIZE), FINALIZE, read 32-byte digest. Verify matches direct wc_Sha256 of the same data.
3. GCM encrypt streaming: write in chunks, read partial ciphertext after each write, FINALIZE, read tag. Verify full ciphertext+tag matches one-shot.
4. GCM decrypt streaming: confirm that plaintext is NOT returned until FINALIZE (all read() calls before FINALIZE return 0), FINALIZE verifies tag, then read() returns plaintext.
5. Error case: write() after FINALIZE returns -EINVAL.
6. Error case: two FINALIZEs return -EINVAL on second.

Thread safety: existing 16-thread concurrency test already covers concurrent sessions — verify it still passes.
close_reason: Created tests/userspace/test_chardev.c: CBC NIST CAVP vectors (oneshot + streaming), GCM encrypt/decrypt NIST vectors, SHA-256 hash, FINALIZE error cases (double FINALIZE, write-after-FINALIZE). Compiles clean with gcc -Wall -Wextra.
